ack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approve the
actions that spend credits\n- [MCPJam in Claude](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/claude-connector.md): Connect Claude to your MCPJ
am account through the hosted MCP server — projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing\n- [Okta SSO & SCIM](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/hosted/sso.md): Install MCPJam from the Okta Integration Network and configure SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning\n-

owlists on your MCP and OAuth servers\n- [GitHub Checks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/github-checks.md): Run an eval suite against the

and configuration issues\n- [Error code reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md): What every MCPJam Ins

nnections](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers with different transport meth
ods\n- [Projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/projects.md): Group your MCP servers into projects, with the ability to share

s across versions.\n- [Host Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-compat.md): See which hosts your MCP server will

s.mcpjam.com/inspector/playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand, render widgets, and inspect every step —

un them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.\n- [Compatibility](https://docs.
